newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroders rates Hwa Hong.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroders rates Hwa Hong.

text.p: The property assets of Hwa Hong Corporation's are starting to bring higher revenues and profits to the group, said Schroders Securities in its latest investment report on the company.
It rates the stock as an "outperform" and is looking for a medium-term upside target of Singapore $3.00, it said in the report made available to Reuters on Tuesday.
At 0751 GMT, Hwa Hong shares were up 12 cents to S$2.64. Volume was 744,000 units.
Schroders said the company's share price was well supported by its revalued net asset value of S$3.52.
The main contributor to earnings at the moment for the construction based-group is its half share in Trademart, a large office-cum-warehouse complex in Singapore.
The complex, currently fully occupied, has redevelopment potential. Hwa Hong and its partner Parkway Holdings have put the building on the market, said Schroders.
Hwa Hong also has a joint venture with the Bukaka Group in Indonesia for a toll-road project.
Schroders said the project would significantly enhance earnings over the next two decades. There are also plans to list the toll-road project in the future.
